import { ConfigurationCatalog } from './solution';
if (new ConfigurationCatalog([]).get('constructor') !== undefined) throw new Error('Missing setting must not return inherited Object constructor');

prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `Setting`, `ResolvedSettings`, and `ConfigurationCatalog`. A setting has `key`, `value`, and scope `'default' | 'environment'`. The constructor accepts an array of settings and must reject blank keys, duplicate keys within the same scope, and keys whose values are not strings. `resolve()` returns an object whose keys are sorted lexicographically. Environment values override defaults of the same key. `get(key)` returns the effective value or `undefined`; a blank lookup key throws. `withEnvironment(overrides)` returns a new independent catalog containing the same defaults and the supplied environment settings, replacing any previous environment scope. Empty input is valid. Constructor input, override input, and all returned objects must not alias internal state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
